title: 1st March 2011, vide notification No. S.O. 2001(E), 13th August, 2010, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, sec. 3(ii)
text:

. Vide notification No. S.O. 3912(E), dated 30th October, 2019, this Act is made applicable to the Union territory of Jammu and
